analysis_meta.title: Agentic GraphRAG Cost-Effectiveness & Trade-Off Analysis
analysis_meta.philosophy: Objective evaluation across accuracy, evidence groundedness, and resource consumption trade-offs without synthetic winner scores.

quantitative_deltas.accuracy_gain_vs_rag: +68.00% (87/100 vs 19/100 normalized match, +85.00% under strict non-fallback match)
quantitative_deltas.accuracy_gain_vs_graphrag: +67.00% (87/100 vs 20/100 normalized match, +85.00% under strict non-fallback match)
quantitative_deltas.token_delta_vs_rag: -899.16 tokens (avg 7718.01 vs 8617.17 on completed queries; 35% to 76% token reduction on direct comparisons)
quantitative_deltas.latency_delta_vs_rag_ms: +32836.35 ms (overall avg 44125.36 vs 11289.01; on completed queries Agentic is 2.2x FASTER: 39.28s vs 86.44s)

A_both_rag_and_agentic_correct.description: Questions where both RAG and Agentic achieved normalized match. In strict evaluation without UUID hex collisions, only 2 queries (pub-001, pub-003) were genuinely completed and correct in base RAG.

B_agentic_added_cost_and_improved_correc.description: Questions where base RAG failed or crashed, but Agentic GraphRAG successfully resolved the multi-step query with high evidence groundedness.

C_agentic_added_cost_and_still_failed.description: The 13 questions where Agentic GraphRAG did not produce a correct answer, consisting of 2 Superlatives (correct entity found, slight text format difference), 10 Multi-Hop queries, and 1 Temporal query (6 of which were 120s HTTP timeout limits).

D_agentic_improved_evidence_without_corr.description: Questions where Agentic successfully located and grounded the gold evidence (gold_combined_hit = True) but failed strict accuracy due to phrasing or parser formatting.

E_agentic_reduced_token_cost_vs_rag.description: Populated benchmark questions where Agentic GraphRAG consumed significantly fewer tokens than base RAG by offloading reasoning to TigerGraph GSQL tools.

narrative_corrections.redundant_planning_claim_audit: The claim of 19 redundant planning questions is INVALIDATED. It was an artifact of 17 single-digit UUID hex collisions in crashed RAG fallback strings. In reality, only 2 questions were genuinely answered by both RAG and Agentic.
narrative_corrections.unresolved_multihop_claim_audit: The claim of 13 unresolved multi-hop questions is CLARIFIED. The 13 failures comprise 10 Multi-Hop, 2 Superlative, and 1 Temporal question. 6 of these 13 were hard 120s timeouts on complex joint graph-vector traversals.
